Class AbstractGame

java.lang.Object
com.example.cincuentazo.model.AbstractsClasses.AbstractGame
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGame
Direct Known Subclasses:
Game
public abstract class AbstractGame extends Object implements IGame
Abstract implementation of the game logic. This class manages players, turns, cards, score calculation, and the overall state of the match.
Version:
1.0
Author:
José David Hurtado
